description: Investigation dashboard for shared/replayed Akamai hdntl session tokens. Extracts the hmac from error URLs, counts distinct IPs/sessions per token, and drills down into a single token via the $token variable.

panels.description: Exact totals computed server-side over ALL shared tokens (bucket_selector + pipeline aggs, up to 10k tokens), not just the rows shown in the table. 'Distinct tokens' is uncapped (cardinality).
panels.title: Token sharing summary

panels.description: Distribution of hdntl tokens by how many distinct IPs errored with them. Anything right of the first bar is token replay.

targets.root_selector: ($b := aggregations.by_token.buckets; [{"group": "1 IP (not shared)", "tokens": aggregations.total_tokens.value - aggregations.shared_tokens.count}, {"group": "2 IPs", "tokens": $count([$filter($b, function($x) { $x.ips.value = 2 })])}, {"group": "3-5 IPs", "tokens": $count([$filter($b, function($x) { $x.ips.value >= 3 and $x.ips.value <= 5 })])}, {"group": "6-10 IPs", "tokens": $count([$filter($b, function($x) { $x.ips.value >= 6 and $x.ips.value <= 10 })])}, {"group": "11+ IPs", "tokens": $count([$filter($b, function($x) { $x.ips.value > 10 })])}])

panels.title: Tokens by number of sharing IPs

panels.description: Errors whose data.url carries an hdntl token, against all errors. A widening hdntl share under load points at token/manifest problems.
panels.title: Errors over time: tokenized URLs vs all

panels.description: TOP 500 tokens only - see the summary stat for exact totals. Each row is one hdntl (hmac) from error URLs; IPs > 1 means replayed across users. 'Minted' = exp - 24h. Click a token to drill down.
panels.title: Top 500 hdntl tokens by distinct IPs

panels.description: All events whose data.url contains the selected token, grouped by IP. Media/platform filters are intentionally NOT applied (acl=/* tokens work on any stream).
panels.title: IPs using selected token ($token)

panels.description: Raw error events whose URL contains the selected token.
panels.title: Error events for selected token ($token)
Token lifetime - ALL media (time range only)

panels.description: Events whose hdntl was older than 24h at use, vs all hdntl events (ALL media, time-range only).
panels.title: Requests made with expired tokens

panels.description: Every hdntl-carrying event, bucketed by how old its token was when used (event time - mint time). The hdntl lives 24h: bars at >= 24h are requests made with an ALREADY-EXPIRED token.
panels.title: Events by token age at use (hours since mint) - ALL media

panels.description: Only time-range filtered (media/platform ignored). Tokens seen in >1 session. 'Active span' = last use - first use. 'Used past exp by' > 0 means the token was still presented AFTER its 24h expiry - the expired_token mechanism.
panels.title: Token lifetime - repeated tokens, ALL media (worst past-expiry first)

panels.description: IPs ordered by distinct devices behind them. An IP with hundreds of devices is a carrier gateway (e.g. mobile CGNAT), not one user - crucial when interpreting Akamai's per-IP counts.
panels.title: Devices per IP - shared egress / CGNAT detector (ALL media)

title: hdntl Token Sharing Investigation
